# foundation-lite-1: CMS previews show the two new D-14 fields

**Status (integration, 2026-10-25):** APPLIED as written: `public/admin/preview-templates.js` (DirectionPreview shows "On the home page: …"; HomePreview shows statement, why and mission, with the new note), and the test in `tests/unit/cms/preview.test.ts`.

**From:** FOUNDATION-LITE (simplify), 2026-10-25. **To:** the owner of `public/admin/preview-templates.js` (hand-written, not generated by `npm run cms:config`).

**Why.** FOUNDATION-LITE added two optional fields (DECISIONS D-14):

- `directions.home_question`: the short question a pearl shows on the homepage (≤ 90 characters). CMS label: "Short question for the homepage (optional)".
- `pages/home.why`: the concrete line under the homepage heading. CMS label: "Why it matters (under the heading)".

Both are in `public/admin/config.yml`, so editors can already fill them in. But the editor preview does not show them yet, and the home preview note still describes the D-13 layout ("The mission under the lab name").

**Patch** (`public/admin/preview-templates.js`):

```diff
@@ DirectionPreview (around line 749)
         has(d.question) ? h("p", { className: "t-lead" }, d.question) : null,
+        has(d.home_question)
+          ? h(
+              "p",
+              { className: "cms-preview__meta" },
+              "On the home page: ",
+              h("strong", null, d.home_question),
+            )
+          : null,
         has(d.summary) ? h("p", null, d.summary) : null,
@@ HomePreview (around line 1096)
       Note(
         [
           h("strong", { key: "a" }, "Preview. "),
-          "The mission under the lab name, and the home page’s featured findings.",
+          "The line under the home page heading (the mission when it is empty), and the featured findings. The mission is also the About page’s “Mission” and the search-result description.",
         ],
         false,
       ),
+      has(d.statement) ? h("h1", { key: "statement" }, d.statement) : null,
+      has(d.why) ? h("p", { className: "t-lead", key: "why" }, d.why) : null,
-      has(d.mission) ? h("p", { className: "t-lead", key: "mission" }, d.mission) : null,
+      has(d.mission)
+        ? h("p", { className: has(d.why) ? "cms-preview__meta" : "t-lead", key: "mission" }, d.mission)
+        : null,
```

**Test** (`tests/unit/cms/preview.test.ts`, inside the existing pages test, next to the `home` render):

```ts
const home2 = textOf(
  render("home", { statement: "S.", why: "Why line.", mission: "We study work." }),
);
expect(home2).toContain("S.");
expect(home2).toContain("Why line.");
expect(home2).toContain("We study work.");
const dir = textOf(render("directions", { title: "T", home_question: "Short?" }));
expect(dir).toContain("On the home page: Short?");
```

(Adjust `render("directions", …)` to the helper's real collection name if it differs.)

**Risk:** none for the public site. These are editor-only previews, and the axe check of the CMS (`tests/e2e/cms-local.spec.ts`) covers the iframe.
